newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank to cut reserve requirement in April.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank to cut reserve requirement in April.

text.p: Croatia's central bank said on Wednesday it would cut reserve requirement by one percentage point to 34.85 percent from April 1.
The reserve ratio has been unchanged at 35.85 percent of commercial banks' kuna deposits since being lowered by 1.1 points in October 1996.

Its easing follows a March cut in the discount rate to 5.9 from 6.5 percent and slashing of the Lombard emergency lending rate to 9.5 precent from 11 previously. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
